title: Release Tracking
selectProject: Select a project to track a release.

views.dependenciesHint: Release dependency analysis is future work and is not available yet.

help.direct: Features assigned to this release and owned by a team in the current scope. A Feature that names no team belongs to every scope.
help.derived: Features outside this release that have a story or defect assigned to it. Counted, but not given a percentage: the denominator would be only the children in this release, not the whole Feature.
help.unparented: Stories and defects in this release that have no parent Feature.

burnup.title: Burnup {{release}} - {{from}} - {{to}}
burnup.partialHistory: Some days have no recorded snapshot and are shown as gaps rather than as zero.
burnup.noBaseline: No approved release target is recorded, so no target baseline is drawn.

empty.title: No burnup history
empty.description: The burnup is built from daily snapshots of this release. None have been recorded for this window yet, so no history can be shown.

burnup.tableCaption: Burnup for {{release}} as a table: Accepted, Planned, Preliminary Estimate and the target baseline, per day of the release window.

error.title: Could not load the burnup
error.body: The request failed, so no burnup history could be read. This is not a statement about the release — try again.

issues.badgeLabel: Children assigned to a different release
issues.badgeHeading_one: {{count}} child item points at another release
issues.badgeHeading_other: {{count}} child items point at another release
issues.fullMismatch: All release-assigned child items mismatch this selected Release. Check whether the Feature release is stale or assigned to the wrong Release.

noRelease.title: No releases in this project
noRelease.description: Release Tracking follows a release. Create one under Plan > Timeboxes to track it here.

direct.title: No Features in this release
direct.description: No Feature is assigned directly to the selected release in this scope.

derived.title: No derived Features
derived.description: No Feature outside this release has a child story or defect assigned to it in this scope.

unparented.title: No unparented items
unparented.description: Every story and defect in this release belongs to a Feature.

noMatch.title: No matches in this list
noMatch.description: Nothing in the selected list matches your search. Search covers the whole list, not just this page - clear it to see every row.

error.title: Could not load release tracking
error.description: The list failed to load. This is not an empty release - retry, and check the connection if it persists.
